newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious were called to open mixed Monday, with gold drifting back in the bullion market overnight after setting a two-week high Friday on heavy fund shortcovering.
COMEX August gold was called unchanged to down $1.00 from Friday's close of $329.60 an ounce, reflecting fears that resistance around $330.00 will hold.

In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted at $328.10/50 early, compared to the London morning fix of $328.05, the highest fix since July 3, after gold closed around $328.70/$329.20 in New York Friday.
Gold prices jumped sharply last Thursday and Friday on fund, trade house and commission house shortcovering after gold fell to a 12-year low early in July.
COMEX September silver was called up 1.0 to 2.0 cents from Friday's finish of $4.270 after trading from $4.295 to $4.32 on ACCESS.
NYMEX October platinum was called unchanged to down $1.00 from Friday's close of $399.30, but NYMEX September palladium was called unchanged to up $1.00 from the previous close of $166.35.
Russian palladium supplies resumed this week, after a suspension of six months, but reports Monday indicated platinum supplies had been delayed.
